task: Compare Apple watches and  learn more about the ultra version on apple.
agent_final_answer:
Completed both parts on apple.com: (1) compared Apple Watch models via apple.com/watch/compare, and (2) learned more about the Ultra version via the Apple Watch Ultra 3 page (apple.com/apple-watch-ultra-3).

PART 1 - APPLE WATCH COMPARISON (Series 11 vs SE 3 vs Ultra 3):
- Starting price: Series 11 from $399; SE 3 from $249; Ultra 3 from $799.
- Case: Series 11 = 46mm or 42mm aluminum/titanium; SE 3 = 44mm or 40mm aluminum; Ultra 3 = 49mm titanium only.
- Display: all Always-On Retina; max brightness Series 11 = 2000 nits, SE 3 = 1000 nits, Ultra 3 = 3000 nits (brightest).
- Battery: Series 11 up to 24 hrs (38 hrs Low Power); SE 3 up to 18 hrs (32 hrs Low Power); Ultra 3 up to 42 hrs (72 hrs Low Power) - the longest.
- Water resistance: Series 11 & SE 3 = 50m; Ultra 3 = 100m with scuba to 40m, depth gauge, EN13319 dive cert.
- GPS: Ultra 3 has Precision dual-frequency (L1+L5) GPS, best in a sports watch; others standard.
- Chip: all use S10 chip, 64GB, 4-core Neural Engine, double tap + wrist flick gestures.
- Health: Series 11 and Ultra 3 both have ECG, Blood Oxygen, Hypertension notifications; SE 3 lacks ECG/Blood Oxygen/Hypertension. All three have sleep apnea notifications, sleep score, Vitals app, temperature sensing.
- Ultra 3 exclusives: Emergency SOS via satellite, satellite messaging/Find My, built-in Siren, customizable Action button, dual speakers, 3-mic array, MIL-STD 810H tested, IP6X dust resistant, expanded altimeter (-500m to 9000m).

PART 2 - LEARN MORE ABOUT THE ULTRA VERSION (Apple Watch Ultra 3, "Personal beast," from $799):
The ultimate sports and adventure watch. Key highlights:
- 49mm rugged titanium case (Natural or Black titanium), tough sapphire crystal display.
- Brightest, largest wide-angle Always-On display (up to 3000 nits).
- Longest battery: up to 42 hrs normal use, 72 hrs in Low Power Mode; fast charge 15 min for up to 12 hrs use; up to 14 hrs outdoor workout with full GPS.
- Built-in satellite communications: Emergency SOS, Messages, and Find My via satellite (free for 2 years) for staying connected off-grid; 5G cellular.
- Running/sports: precision dual-frequency GPS (best in a sports watch), advanced metrics (running power, cadence, VO2 max), Custom Workouts, training load, Heart Rate Zones, Race Route, Pacer, Workout Buddy (Apple Intelligence), Multisport, swim stroke detection.
- Adventure: customizable Action button, Backtrack, custom hiking routes, offline maps, Compass waypoints, Oceanic+ full dive computer (Buhlmann algorithm) to 40m, Tides app.
- Safety: Emergency SOS, Fall Detection, Crash Detection, Check In, Siren audible to 600 ft/180 m, flashlight, Medical ID.
- Health: hypertension notifications, ECG app, Blood Oxygen, sleep score, sleep apnea notifications, Vitals app, Cycle Tracking, heart rate notifications.
- Requires iPhone 11 or later with iOS 26 or later. Made with 40% recycled material; ships in 100% fiber-based packaging.
